Custom by Rugs USA: Our custom rugs are cut to fit your exact space.

Changing your mind is totally okay—returns are pretty straightforward.

You can return most items within 30 days of delivery as long as they’re in the same condition as received.
Start the process online using our return portal, which will email you a prepaid Rugs USA label (return shipping cost is deducted from your refund).
Each item needs its own label and must be securely wrapped (original packaging or heavy-duty plastic/box, with old labels removed or covered).
After you print and attach the label, just drop it off at a FedEx location near you; you can find one via FedEx’s “Find My Location” tool.
Once your return arrives, processing typically takes 5–10 business days, then another 5–7 business days for your bank/credit card to show the refund.
You can choose store credit or a refund to your original payment method (some exceptions like Facebook Shop orders get store credit only).

So overall, the process is pretty user-friendly: it’s all online, label-based, and handled through FedEx drop-off, with clear timelines for your refund or credit.
